title: Sam Sand Dunes Camel Safari & Desert Swiss Tents
description: Swiss tents under desert stars with live Kalbelia dance, camel dune ride, and authentic woodfire Dal Baati Churma.

title: Amber Fort & Hawa Mahal Heritage Walk + Blue Pottery
description: Explore Amber Fort, Jal Mahal, and Hawa Mahal with a certified royal historian. Includes a hands-on GI blue pottery session.

title: Lake Pichola Royal Haveli & Sunset Boat Cruise
description: Historic Mewari lakeside haveli overlooking the City Palace and Jag Mandir. Includes evening sunset boat cruise.

title: Mehrangarh Fort & Blue City Brahmin Alley Walk
description: Imposing hill fort exploration followed by walking through indigo-blue alleys of Navchokiya with piping hot Mirchi Vada.

title: Alleppey Backwater Eco-Houseboat & Village Canoe Cruise
description: Traditional wooden Kettuvallam through palm canals. Fresh Karimeen Pollichathu meal and canoe paddle into toddy village groves.

title: Munnar Eravikulam Tea Hills & Spice Plantation Trek
description: Walk through lush rolling tea carpets, spot endangered Nilgiri Tahr, and taste single-estate high-grown orthodox tea.

title: Fort Kochi Chinese Fishing Nets & Kathakali Night
description: Sunset along iconic wooden Chinese fishing nets, Jewish Synagogue, Mattancherry palace, and front-row traditional Kathakali theater.

title: Wayanad Rainforest Treehouse & Chembra Peak Trek
description: Perched 60 feet above the forest canopy amidst cardamom estates. Trek to the famous heart-shaped lake at Chembra Peak.

title: Old Manali Apple Orchard Wooden Chalet & Solang Pass
description: Cedarwood cottage surrounded by heirloom apple orchards. Snow peak views of Solang Valley, bukhari stoves, and fresh Siddu.

title: Shimla British Heritage Ridge Walk & Toy Train Experience
description: Historic colonial Mall Road, Christ Church, and Viceregal Lodge walk, with scenic Kalka-Shimla mountain toy train ride.

title: Spiti Valley Key Monastery & Mud-Brick Village Homestay
description: Explore 1,000-year-old Key Gompa perched on a cliff at 13,600 ft. Stargaze in zero-pollution skies at Hikkim and Langza.

title: Dharamshala Tibetan Monasteries & Kangra Tea Trail
description: Tsuglagkhang Dalai Lama temple complex, Norbulingka Institute Tibetan arts, and century-old Kangra green tea estates.

title: Rishikesh Holy Ganga River Rafting & Cliffside Camp
description: Thrilling Grade III+ river rafting through Marine Drive rapids, cliff jumping into the holy Ganga, and evening Triveni Ghat Aarti.

title: Nainital Lakefront Heritage Stay & Naini Peak Trek
description: Overlooking eye-shaped Naini Lake. Boating, cable car ride to Snow View Point, and guided rhododendron forest trail to China Peak.

title: Jim Corbett Tiger Safari & Ramganga River Jungle Lodge
description: Open 4x4 Jeep Safari through Dhikala & Bijrani zones tracking wild Royal Bengal tigers, Asiatic elephants, and gharials.

title: Mussoorie Queen of Hills & Landour Colonial Bakehouse Walk
description: Quiet pine-covered trails of Landour, Char Dukan pancakes, Ruskin Bond landmarks, and sweeping Doon Valley vistas.

title: Coorg Rainforest Coffee & Pepper Estate Stay
description: Planter bungalow amidst 100 acres of Arabica coffee and pepper. Includes stream trekking, coffee roasting, and Kodava feast.

title: Hampi UNESCO Boulder Ruins & Tungabhadra Coracle Boat
description: Dawn tour of Vijayanagara empire, stone chariot, musical pillars, and sunset coracle boat ride on Tungabhadra river.

title: Mysore Palace Grand Illumination & Sandalwood Silk Trail
description: Explore the 100,000-bulb illuminated Amba Vilas Palace, century-old Devaraja flower market, and Mysore silk weaving karkhana.

title: Gokarna Om Beach Cliffside Eco-Hut & Arabian Sea Sunset
description: Rustic thatched huts overlooking Om Beach and Kudle Beach. Yoga at sunrise, dolphin spotting boat rides, and Mahabaleshwar temple.

title: Divar Island Cycling & Goan Feni Heritage Trail
description: Ferry over to tranquil Divar Island. Cycle past Portuguese villas, ancient paddy fields, and visit a traditional cashew feni distillery.

title: Palolem Beach Kayaking & Secret Butterfly Beach Cruise
description: Paddle sea kayaks through calm turquoise bays, discover hidden Butterfly Beach, and spot playful Indo-Pacific humpback dolphins.

title: Chettinad Heritage Mansion Walk & 18-Spice Feast
description: Tour 19th-century merchant mansions with Burma teak pillars and Italian marble. Hands-on stone-grinding Chettinad pepper feast.

title: Madurai Meenakshi Amman Temple Dawn Architectural Tour
description: Witness morning temple rituals amidst 33,000 sculpted figures, the Hall of Thousand Pillars, and taste Madurai Jigarthanda.

title: Ooty Nilgiri Mountain Toy Train & Botanical Heritage Stay
description: Ride the UNESCO steam railway to Coonoor through 250 bridges. Stay in heritage stone cottages with eucalyptus wood fires.

title: Mahabaleshwar Strawberry Agro-Farm & Warli Art Camp
description: Pluck winter strawberries directly from organic farm rows. Enjoy fresh strawberry cream and paint authentic Warli tribal murals.

title: Ajanta & Ellora UNESCO Ancient Rock-Cut Caves Tour
description: Marvel at Kailash Temple carved from a single basalt rock cliff and 2,000-year-old Buddhist fresco paintings in Ajanta.

title: South Mumbai Colonial Heritage & Art Deco Walking Tour
description: Gateway of India, Chhatrapati Shivaji Terminus (VT), Marine Drive Queen’s Necklace, and Irani cafe bun-maska chai.

title: Dal Lake Handcrafted Cedarwood Houseboat & Shikara
description: Carved walnut wood houseboat on Dal Lake. Sunrise floating flower and vegetable market tour by wooden Shikara with saffron Kahwa.

title: Gulmarg Apharwat Gondola Snow Ride & Pine Lodge
description: Ride the world’s second-highest operating cable car to 13,780 ft. Ski, snowboard, or cozy up in pine-panelled alpine lodges.

title: Pahalgam Betaab Valley & Baisaran Meadow Horse Trail
description: Pony ride through dense pine forests to Baisaran (Mini Switzerland), riverside Lidder trout fishing, and Aru Valley.

title: Nubra Valley High-Altitude Camel Safari & Homestay
description: Ride double-humped Bactrian camels across white sand dunes surrounded by glaciers. Savor steamed momos and butter tea.

title: Pangong Tso Blue Lake High-Altitude Glamping Camp
description: Luxury insulated tents on the shores of 14,270 ft Pangong Tso. Watch the crystal waters change colors from turquoise to deep indigo.

title: Subah-e-Banaras Sunrise Boat & Silk Karkhana Walk
description: Sunrise wooden rowing boat along sacred Ganges ghats with morning ragas, followed by a walk into real zari pit-loom workshops.

title: Taj Mahal Sunrise Tour & Mughal Pietra Dura Inlay Craft
description: Watch the sunrise turn white Makrana marble golden. Visit direct descendants of Mughal artisans crafting marble inlay.

title: Ayodhya Saryu River Evening Aarti & Ram Temple Trail
description: Spiritual walk through the grand temple complex, Hanuman Garhi, and sunset motorized wooden boat on holy Saryu river with lamp floating.

title: Darjeeling Tea Estate Heritage Planter Bungalow
description: Colonial tea bungalow with clear views of Mt. Kanchenjunga. Pluck fine tea leaves and enjoy First Flush cupping sessions.

title: Kolkata Victoria Memorial, Tram Ride & College Street Books
description: Ride vintage electric trams to College Street Boi Para, savor kathi rolls and mishti doi, and tour marble Victoria Memorial.

title: Sundarbans Mangrove Royal Bengal Tiger Boat Safari
description: Cruise through tidal creeks and estuarine mangrove forests tracking elusive swimming tigers, saltwater crocodiles, and mudskippers.

title: Rann of Kutch Bhunga Mud-Art Homestay & Rogan Art
description: Stay in cylindrical clay Bhunga decorated with Lippan mirror work. Visit Nirona masters for 300-year-old Rogan fabric painting.

title: Gir National Park Asiatic Lion Open Jeep Safari
description: Open 4x4 forest department safari across deciduous teak forests. Encounter wild Asiatic lion prides and visit Maldhari pastoral hamlets.

title: Cherrapunji Living Root Bridges Rainforest Trek
description: Trek down 3,500 ancient stone steps to the Double Decker Living Root Bridge. Swim in turquoise natural pools and explore sacred groves.

title: Kaziranga One-Horned Rhino Safari & Mishing Village
description: Open 4x4 jeep safari through tall grassland forests tracking wild one-horned rhinoceroses. Visit stilt Mishing villages for handloom weaving.

title: Khajuraho Sculptural Heritage & Bundeli Terracotta
description: In-depth architectural guided walk through the western temple group sculptures, followed by pottery wheel toy making in rural village.

title: Bandhavgarh Royal Bengal Tiger Safari & Jungle Resort
description: Experience India’s highest tiger density park on morning and afternoon game drives, with evening tribal Baiga dance performances.

title: Amritsar Golden Temple Langar Sewa & Wagah Border
description: Dawn spiritual tour of Harmandir Sahib, volunteer in the 100,000-meal kitchen, and attend the high-energy Wagah Border retreat ceremony.

title: Raghurajpur Pattachitra Heritage Village Studio Walk
description: Explore the world-famous village where every house is an art studio. Learn palm-leaf engraving and watch Gotipua dance performance.

title: Gangtok Rumtek Monastery & Tsomgo Glacier Lake Expedition
description: Visit the sacred 12,400 ft glacial Tsomgo lake, ride decorated yaks, and tour 16th Karmapa seat at majestic Rumtek Monastery.

title: Araku Valley Organic Coffee Plantations & Borra Caves
description: Scenic glass-domed Vistadome train ride up Eastern Ghats hills, organic Araku coffee tastings, and million-year-old limestone Borra caves.

title: Hyderabad Golconda Fort Sound-and-Light & Charminar Biryani
description: Acoustic marvels of Golconda Fort, sunset walk around 430-year-old Charminar, Laad Bazaar pearl bangles, and dum biryani tasting.

title: Bodh Gaya Mahabodhi Temple & Ancient Nalanda University
description: Meditation under the sacred Bodhi Tree where Buddha attained enlightenment, followed by the ruins of 5th-century Nalanda University.

title: Old Delhi Chandni Chowk Rickshaw Food Trail & Red Fort
description: Cycle-rickshaw glide through Asia’s largest spice market (Khari Baoli), Paranthe Wali Gali, Jama Masjid, and majestic Red Fort.

title: Havelock Island Radhanagar Beach & Coral Reef Scuba Diving
description: Scuba dive into vibrant coral gardens with sea turtles at Elephant Beach. Relax on Radhanagar Beach, rated among Asia’s best beaches.
